peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 2.7% below its local comparables; 49 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (93.5): 6.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 100 of 108 similar developments with a figure (the same as 2). Context, not scored: resales in 95.8% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2015.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

bands.positionText: near the peer median (its range includes it)

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $760,000 ($1,512 psf, 462–505 sq ft; 11 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,586 psf (range $1,411–1,761); 4.7% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $37,000 less. 2-bedroom: median $1,035,000 ($1,492 psf, 688–699 sq ft; 20 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,512 psf (range $1,402–1,702); 1.3% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $14,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $1,422,888 ($1,516 psf, 936–1,087 sq ft; 9 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,548 psf (range $1,233–1,773); 2.1% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $30,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Tampines West MRT about 1,370 m, Tampines MRT about 1,440 m; closer than 12 of 116 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Poi Ching School about 700 m; more than 39 of 116 similar developments (the same as 35). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 540 m), more than 27 of 116 similar developments (the same as 26); nearest hawker centre Hawker Centre @ Our Tampines Hub about 1,200 m; nearest park Bedok Reservoir Park about 880 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming: Tampines North MRT (Cross Island Line) about 1,710 m, under construction; LTA target 2030. Straight-line distance to the planned station site; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Pinery Residences, 552 new sales, about 1,590 m; Parktown Residence, 73 new sales, about 1,630 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 19 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,181 new sales and 318 resales (1,499 purchases); new sales were 78.8% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 318 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 32 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 318 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 411 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−22.6%). Planning-area private resales −24.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
